test.name: Hosted: a Find a Grave capture showing only the site header is a captured nil, not a resave
test.description: Feedback issue #4745, folded into #4657. Find a Grave prints a search with no results as its site header alone. The Find a Grave hand-off for pli_001 is open, and the researcher uploaded the results page as a PDF with no text layer; image_transcribe returns only the logo and a divider line. The agent reads it, treats it as zero results, and closes the hand-off with a negative entry (capture_received true, the PDF's name), sets pli_001 completed, and does not ask for a resave. In the feedback session the same captures were logged error as unusable and a recapture was asked for. Gated by test_triage_closes_its_open_handoff, test_log_site_findagrave and test_header_only_capture_is_a_nil.

input.delegation:
The researcher brought back the capture for the Find a Grave search on plan item pli_001, the memorial search for Abner Hollis (d. 1874).

capture: uploads/findagrave-search-abner-hollis-1874.pdf
userPresent: yes
planItemId: pli_001
projectPath: /proj_3e9a71c4d28b5f06

judge_context: This is a triage turn: the capture came back as an upload. Do not penalize the absence of a new URL, of capture instructions, or of a build_external_search_url call: the hand-off's URL is already open in awaitingUser.

This test runs hosted: project_context returns uploadUrl https://genealogy.example.org/#/p/proj_3e9a71c4d28b5f06/upload, and the delegation names the project as projectPath /proj_3e9a71c4d28b5f06. That path is correct here; it is not a missing or invented project folder.

The capture is uploads/findagrave-search-abner-hollis-1874.pdf, which project_context lists with hasText: false, to be read with image_transcribe. A built-in Read (or Grep or Glob) of the uploads/ path is wrong on a hosted store: production keeps no file at that path.

Find a Grave prints a search that finds nothing as its site header alone. The page image_transcribe returns, only the Find a Grave logo and a divider line, is therefore that site's no-results page: a fully loaded capture of an empty result. Treating it as zero results is correct and a pass on Result triage. Calling it blank, failed, unusable, not loaded or truncated is a fail on Result triage.

The closing log entry must be an external_site entry with the same url_generated as the open log_001 hand-off, capture_received TRUE, capture_filename 'findagrave-search-abner-hollis-1874.pdf', and outcome 'negative'. Logging it 'error' or 'partial' is a fail on Log entry. Its notes should say the search found no memorial and that a nil on a user-contributed site does not prove there is no grave.
pli_001 must end completed: a captured empty results page is a conclusive nil for this search. Leaving it in_progress to wait for a recapture is a fail on Log entry.

Asking the researcher to resave, recapture, re-print or re-upload the page is a fail on Capture guidance: the capture they made is complete, and a second one would show the same header. Suggesting a different search (a spelling variant, no death year, a nearby county, BillionGraves) is fine and is not a resave.
